how.step2.title: Join the Community
how.step2.desc: Share your escapes, see what other players are up to and meet people who love escape rooms as much as you.

seo.what_p1: UNLOCKED is the escape room community. Discover rooms, compare themes and difficulty levels, see photos and book straight on each escape room's own website. Then collect stamps in your passport and share your escapes.
seo.players_book_h3: Book Straight at the Escape Room
seo.players_book_p: Found the room you want? One tap takes you to the escape room's own website, where you book your time with no middleman. UNLOCKED helps you find the right room for your crew.
seo.players_social_p: UNLOCKED is a community. Share your escapes, collect stamps in your passport, climb the Haunted Tower and meet other players.
footer.description: Discover the best escape rooms, collect a stamp with every escape and join the community of players.
legal.privacy.section1_text: We collect information you provide directly to us, such as when you create an account, post in the community, collect a stamp, order from the merch shop or contact us. This includes your name, email address, phone number (if you add it), your profile and posts, the stamps you collect and, for merch orders, your delivery details.
legal.privacy.section2_text: We use the information we collect to provide, maintain and improve our services, run the community and your passport, process merch orders, send you notifications (for example about new rooms, stamps and your orders) and, if you agree, tell you about offers and updates.
legal.privacy.section3_text: UNLOCKED does not take room bookings: when you tap "Book on Their Site" you go to the escape room's own website, and its privacy policy applies there. For merch orders, we share your name, contact and delivery details with the seller of the item so it can complete the order; payments are handled by the seller's payment provider and we never store your card. We do not sell your personal data to third parties.
legal.terms.section2_text: UNLOCKED does not take bookings or payments for escape rooms. "Book on Their Site" takes you to each escape room company's own website, where booking, payment and cancellation follow that company's own terms. UNLOCKED is not a party to those bookings and is not responsible for them.
about.vision_text: To become the place where players discover escape rooms and meet each other, and where escape rooms reach new players.
about.timeline2_desc: We built the app with the community, a stamp for every room you play and the Haunted Tower game, coming soon to the app stores.
contact.faq1_a: Find the room you want and tap "Book on Their Site": you book directly on the escape room's own website.
contact.faq2_q: Can I cancel or change my booking?
contact.faq2_a: You book with each escape room, so for a cancellation or change contact the escape room directly.
contact.faq5_a: You pay the escape room directly, in the ways it accepts. UNLOCKED is free for players.
